lines.zh: 我随洋流漂移，触须先探前方的礁石。
lines.en: I drift with the current, tentacles testing the reef ahead.

lines.zh: 一收一放，我把海水挤成前进的力气。
lines.en: I squeeze and release, turning seawater into forward motion.

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚上方缓缓平移，像一盏灯。
lines.en: I slide above the coral, slow as a hanging lantern.

lines.zh: 水压变了，我朝更深的那道沟漂过去。
lines.en: The pressure shifts; I drift toward the deeper trench.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖一张一合，替沉船残骸计数。
lines.en: My bell opens and closes, counting the wreck's broken ribs.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙地掠过，避开会勾住触须的骨头。
lines.en: I skim the sand, dodging bones that would snag my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我浮过海草林，光在身后拖得很长。
lines.en: I float past the kelp forest, trailing a long line of light.

lines.zh: 我每向前一寸，体内就轻轻嗡一声。
lines.en: Every inch forward hums a little louder inside me.

lines.zh: 我绕过沉船桅杆，不想碰响它。
lines.en: I circle the sunken mast, unwilling to make it ring.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向上层水面，那里亮得刺眼。
lines.en: I turn slowly for the bright surface, where light stings.

lines.zh: 我顺着一道暖流走，暖流让我发胀。
lines.en: I follow a warm current, and the warmth makes me swell.

lines.zh: 我漂过一群鱼，鱼比我先散开。
lines.en: I drift through a school of fish; they scatter first.

lines.zh: 我朝洞穴收缩身体，把自己挤成细长一条。
lines.en: I pinch myself thin to slip into the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 我在水层里画着圆弧，像被谁牵着线。
lines.en: I trace slow circles through the water, as if on a string.

lines.zh: 我漂到哪儿，哪儿就少一条鱼。
lines.en: Wherever I drift, there's one less fish.

lines.zh: 我的触须缠过桅杆，又松开。
lines.en: My tentacles wrap the mast and let go again.

lines.zh: 我停在原地，听海水自己说话。
lines.en: I hold still and let the water do the talking.

lines.zh: 我的触须垂下，像一串没点燃的引线。
lines.en: My tentacles hang down like a string of unlit fuses.

lines.zh: 我在暗处半透明，只有在光里才看得清。
lines.en: I am nearly clear in the dark, visible only in light.

lines.zh: 我等一条鱼游得太近，然后后悔没动。
lines.en: I wait for a fish to come close, then regret not moving.

lines.zh: 海水穿过我，我像一块会呼吸的玻璃。
lines.en: Water passes through me; I am breathing glass.

lines.zh: 我静静挂着，把体内那点火气压回去。
lines.en: I hang quietly, pressing the spark inside me down.

lines.zh: 我在礁石缝里待着，数自己闪烁的光。
lines.en: I rest in a reef crevice, counting my own flickering light.

lines.zh: 我一句不说，只说潮汐的节拍。
lines.en: I say nothing but the rhythm of the tide.

lines.zh: 我垂下伞缘，让小鱼在阴影里休息。
lines.en: I lower my bell's rim so small fish can rest in shade.

lines.zh: 我悬在半水里，像被钉住的一颗气泡。
lines.en: I hover mid-water, a pinned bubble with nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 我不饿也不困，只等水变凉。
lines.en: I am neither hungry nor sleepy; I wait for the chill.

lines.zh: 我把自己收小，免得惊动头顶的海龟。
lines.en: I shrink myself so the turtle overhead won't notice.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里发着微光，只照亮自己。
lines.en: I glow faintly in the dark, lighting only myself.

lines.zh: 我安静得让螃蟹爬过去，没有碰我。
lines.en: I stay so still a crab walks past without touching me.

lines.zh: 我抬高伞盖，隔着水看你的火把。
lines.en: I lift my bell and watch your torch through the water.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味很重，比海水更重。
lines.en: The iron on you smells heavier than the sea.

lines.zh: 我把触须朝你转过去，只是在辨认。
lines.en: I turn my tentacles toward you, only to identify.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，那里踩碎了珊瑚。
lines.en: I stare at your boots; the coral cracked there.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸冒成气泡，我一直看它上升。
lines.en: Your breath becomes bubbles, and I follow them up.

lines.zh: 我看你腰间的镐子，那东西能敲开石头。
lines.en: I look at your pick; that thing can open stone.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里停住，影子比水凉。
lines.en: I stop in your shadow, which is colder than the water.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，看谁先眨眼。
lines.en: You wait, I wait; we shall see who blinks first.

lines.zh: 我认出你是那种会靠近爆炸的人。
lines.en: I recognize the kind of creature that steps toward blasts.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下伞盖，想看清你手里的桶。
lines.en: I tilt my bell to see the bucket in your hand.

lines.zh: 疼，我缩成一团，触须全收回来。
lines.en: That hurts; I curl up and pull every tentacle in.

lines.zh: 你打到我了，我体内的气晃了一下。
lines.en: You hit me, and the gas inside me sloshes.

lines.zh: 我不流血，我只漏出一点光。
lines.en: I do not bleed; I only leak a little light.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己有多薄。
lines.en: That blow reminds me how thin I am.

lines.zh: 疼的感觉在水里传得特别远。
lines.en: Pain travels strangely far through water.

lines.zh: 我退到礁石后面，那里比较安全。
lines.en: I retreat behind the reef, where it is safer.

lines.zh: 你要是再打，我就不得不炸了。
lines.en: Strike me again and I will have to burst.

lines.zh: 我破了一角，海水灌进来，很凉。
lines.en: A corner of me tore; seawater pours in, cold.

lines.zh: 我的光暗了一下，又慢慢亮回来。
lines.en: My glow dips, then slowly comes back.

lines.zh: 你听见那声闷响了吗，我忍住了。
lines.en: Did you hear that muffled pop? I held it in.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼食散开，我浑身都松了。
lines.en: Your fish feed scatters, and every part of me loosens.

lines.zh: 光落在我前面，我忍不住往那边挪。
lines.en: Light falls ahead of me, and I cannot help drifting there.

lines.zh: 我闻到磷虾的味道，触须自己伸过去。
lines.en: I smell krill, and my tentacles reach out on their own.

lines.zh: 你晃桶的动作太像喂食，我信了。
lines.en: The way you swing that bucket looks like feeding; I believe it.

lines.zh: 一小团发亮的东西，比整片海重要。
lines.en: One small glowing morsel matters more than the whole sea.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，像被一根线牵着。
lines.en: I circle you as if tied to a line.

lines.zh: 我明知道你有网，还是游近了。
lines.en: I know you carry a net, and still I come closer.

lines.zh: 那味道让我体内嗡嗡响，压不住。
lines.en: That smell sets me humming, and I cannot press it down.

lines.zh: 我忘了危险，伞盖一开一合地追。
lines.en: I forget danger and pulse after it in plain pursuit.

lines.zh: 你要是撒下一把，我就跟你走一段。
lines.en: Scatter a handful and I will follow you a while.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我体内的空气一下紧了。
lines.en: You bump me, and the gas inside me tightens at once.

lines.zh: 别推，我会记下这次碰撞的力道。
lines.en: Don't push; I will remember the force of this touch.

lines.zh: 我软，可我不是空的，里面全是气。
lines.en: I am soft, but not hollow; I am full of gas.

lines.zh: 触须缠住你了，我慢慢解开。
lines.en: My tentacles caught you, and I am slowly letting go.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，海水发出很闷的一声。
lines.en: We collide, and the water makes a dull, flat sound.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我缩了一整圈。
lines.en: You step back a pace; I shrink a whole turn.

lines.zh: 这一碰让我离爆炸更近了一点。
lines.en: That bump brings me one step nearer to bursting.

lines.zh: 别再推，我里面的气要满了。
lines.en: Do not push again; the gas inside is nearly full.

lines.zh: 我在你护甲上蹭过，留下一道水痕。
lines.en: I brush your armor and leave a line of seawater.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，请把脚抬起来一点。
lines.en: You are standing on me; please lift that foot.

lines.zh: 我们并排漂浮，触须碰一下就分开。
lines.en: We float side by side; tentacles touch once, then part.

lines.zh: 我把我那点光让给它，它先亮了。
lines.en: I offer my little light, and it brightens first.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块礁石转，转得很慢。
lines.en: We circle the same rock, turning very slowly.

lines.zh: 它的伞盖比我的圆，我就跟着它走。
lines.en: Its bell is rounder than mine, so I follow it.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只用一开一合应答。
lines.en: We do not speak; we answer with open and close.

lines.zh: 两团透明的身体贴在一起，像一颗心。
lines.en: Two clear bodies press together and look like a heart.

lines.zh: 我放慢体内的嗡声，怕吵到它。
lines.en: I soften my inner hum so it will not be disturbed.

lines.zh: 我们一起往浅处升，那里更暖。
lines.en: We rise together toward the shallows, where it is warmer.

lines.zh: 它留下的气味我能记很久很久。
lines.en: The scent it leaves I could recall for a very long time.

lines.zh: 我们分开时，谁都没有回头。
lines.en: When we part, neither of us turns back.

lines.zh: 我没有手，你掉的东西只能沉下去。
lines.en: I have no hands; what you drop can only sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸凝胶从我身上滑落，是我的一部分。
lines.en: Explosive gel slips off me, and it is part of me.

lines.zh: 我试着卷起那枚碎片，触须穿了过去。
lines.en: I try to curl around the shard, and my tentacle passes through.

lines.zh: 那东西很重，我托不住，只能看它落。
lines.en: It is heavy; I cannot hold it, only watch it fall.

lines.zh: 你捡吧，我身上没有口袋这种东西。
lines.en: Take it; I have nothing like a pocket.

lines.zh: 我推了一下，它只翻了半圈，没浮起。
lines.en: I nudge it; it rolls half over and still sinks.

lines.zh: 我的触须粘住了它，可我没法带走。
lines.en: My tentacle sticks to it, but I cannot carry it off.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西会引来比我更贪的鱼。
lines.en: Dropped things draw fish greedier than I am.

lines.zh: 我身上的凝胶值钱，我知道，但不给。
lines.en: The gel on me is valuable; I know, and I won't give it.

lines.zh: 我把它让给你，只是因为它压着我。
lines.en: I leave it to you only because it weighs on me.

lines.zh: 你游进我的水域，我的光变亮了。
lines.en: You swim into my water, and my light grows brighter.

lines.zh: 我听见你划水的节奏，乱了。
lines.en: I hear your stroke, and it is out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 有东西在靠近，我体内的气开始转。
lines.en: Something nears, and the gas inside me begins to turn.

lines.zh: 我锁住那团黑影，它比礁石会动。
lines.en: I fix on that dark shape; it moves, unlike the reef.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向鼓了一下伞盖。
lines.en: I pulse my bell once toward where you are.

lines.zh: 触须先感应到震颤，我才转身。
lines.en: My tentacles feel the tremor before I turn.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有东西在我上方游动。
lines.en: I dislike anything swimming above me.

lines.zh: 那条鱼撞了我的触须，我记住它了。
lines.en: That fish struck my tentacle; I have marked it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，不想先用力气。
lines.en: I close in slowly, saving my strength for later.

lines.zh: 你身上有温度，这让我很好奇。
lines.en: You carry warmth, and that makes me curious.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的路线漂，不急着动手。
lines.en: I drift along your path, in no hurry to strike.

lines.zh: 我的触须垂在你必经的那道缝里。
lines.en: My tentacles hang in the gap you must pass.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，一下，两下，三下。
lines.en: I count your breaths: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 我把伞盖压扁，让自己看起来小些。
lines.en: I flatten my bell to look smaller than I am.

lines.zh: 你还没发现我，我已经在等了。
lines.en: You haven't seen me, and I am already waiting.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，水挡住了你的视线。
lines.en: I slip behind you; the water hides me from your eyes.

lines.zh: 每次你快回头，我就停住不动。
lines.en: Each time you almost turn, I stop dead.

lines.zh: 我的光调暗了，只剩伞缘一点。
lines.en: I dim my light to a single rim of faint glow.

lines.zh: 我知道碰一下会怎样，所以没碰。
lines.en: I know what one touch does, so I keep not touching.

lines.zh: 你够近了，我体内的气在收紧。
lines.en: You are close enough now; the gas inside me tightens.

lines.zh: 我的触须扫过去，海水的味道变了。
lines.en: My tentacle sweeps across, and the water's taste changes.

lines.zh: 我不咬也不抓，我只是贴上你。
lines.en: I do not bite or claw; I simply press against you.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，真正的响声在后面。
lines.en: This blow is light; the real noise comes after.

lines.zh: 我撞在你胸口，然后立刻退开。
lines.en: I strike your chest, then back away at once.

lines.zh: 你被我烫了一下，那不是火。
lines.en: You felt a sting from me, and it was not fire.

lines.zh: 我用整副身体推你，像一堵软墙。
lines.en: I shove with my whole body, a wall of softness.

lines.zh: 我的触须缠上你的手腕，甩不掉。
lines.en: My tentacles wrap your wrist; you cannot shake them.

lines.zh: 我每打一下，离炸开就更近一步。
lines.en: Every hit I land brings me closer to going off.

lines.zh: 别以为我慢，水会替我加速。
lines.en: Do not mistake me for slow; the water adds my speed.

lines.zh: 这一碰是警告，下次我不收了。
lines.en: This touch is a warning; next time I won't hold back.

lines.zh: 我在沉船的阴影里成形，先亮了一下。
lines.en: I take shape in the wreck's shadow, flashing once.

lines.zh: 海水把我从一小团气泡吹成现在这样。
lines.en: The sea blew me up from a small knot of bubbles.

lines.zh: 我刚醒来就发现自己装满了气。
lines.en: I woke already filled with gas I never asked for.

lines.zh: 这片水域安静，适合我慢慢长。
lines.en: These waters are quiet, good for growing slowly.

lines.zh: 我从深处升上来，触须还缠着海藻。
lines.en: I rise from the deep with kelp still in my tentacles.

lines.zh: 第一次张伞盖，我自己都吓了一跳。
lines.en: The first time my bell opened, it startled me.

lines.zh: 落在这里不是选择，是水流的意思。
lines.en: Landing here was not my choice; the current decided.

lines.zh: 我数了数周围的同伴，比想象的多。
lines.en: I count the neighbors and find more than I expected.

lines.zh: 我出生就带着一点危险，收不回去。
lines.en: I was born with a little danger in me, and it stays.

lines.zh: 这片海会记住我亮起的第一下。
lines.en: This sea will remember the first time I lit up.

lines.zh: 火在水下也能烧到我，伞盖皱了。
lines.en: Fire burns me underwater, and my bell puckers.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，落地像一袋水。
lines.en: I fall from height and land like a sack of water.

lines.zh: 我本来就活在水里，这像被捂住。
lines.en: I live in water, and this feels like being smothered.

lines.zh: 别人的爆炸把我的气也点着了。
lines.en: Someone else's blast lights the gas inside me.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个会合上的洞。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and leaves a hole that closes itself.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的触须发麻，方向全乱。
lines.en: Magic numbs my tentacles and scrambles my sense of direction.

lines.zh: 我饿得发软，连光都懒得亮。
lines.en: Hunger softens me until I cannot be bothered to glow.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我全身一起亮起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface and my whole body flares.

lines.zh: 虚空没有水，我干得像一张纸。
lines.en: The void has no water; I dry out like paper.
